edges.reason: Constructor mints the entire total supply to msg.sender, making the deployer the initial holder.
enableTrading is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares owner() to msg.sender.
removeLimits is onlyOwner gated.
disableTransferDelay is onlyOwner gated.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount is onlyOwner gated.
updateMaxTxnAmount is onlyOwner gated.
updateMaxWalletAmount is onlyOwner gated.
excludeFromMaxTransaction is onlyOwner gated.
updateSwapEnabled is onlyOwner gated.
updateBuyFees is onlyOwner gated.
updateSellFees is onlyOwner gated.
excludeFromFees is onlyOwner gated.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair is onlyOwner gated.
updateMarketingWallet is onlyOwner gated.
updateDevWallet is onlyOwner gated.
msg.sender is the caller of the overridden _transfer through transfer/transferFrom.
enableTrading stores block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime.
block.timestamp drives the LP burn frequency check inside _transfer.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens records block.timestamp as lastLpBurnTime.
manual burn cooldown compares block.timestamp against lastManualLpBurnTime.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
swapBack indirectly relies on timestamp gated state updated by burn routines.
tx.origin keys _holderLastTransferTimestamp for the one-purchase-per-block anti-bot check.
The swapping flag guards _transfer so swapBack cannot be re-entered recursively.
limitsInEffect gates the transfer limit enforcement block.
tradingActive gates whether non-excluded accounts may transfer.
transferDelayEnabled gates the per-block purchase restriction.
maxTransactionAmount is compared against the transfer amount.
maxWallet bounds amount + balanceOf(to) with arithmetic addition.
swapTokensAtAmount triggers the swapBack call from _transfer.
lpBurnEnabled gates the automatic LP burn branch.
lpBurnFrequency is added to lastLpBurnTime for the burn trigger.
lastLpBurnTime participates in the timestamp-gated burn condition.
_isExcludedFromFees decides whether fees are taken and whether limits apply.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount exempts accounts from cap checks.
automatedMarketMakerPairs determines buy vs sell vs wallet transfer paths.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read and written keyed by tx.origin during transfers.
buyTotalFees is multiplied into the transfer amount to derive buy fees.
sellTotalFees is multiplied into the transfer amount to derive sell fees.
_transfer invokes swapBack while swapping is set to true.
_transfer invokes autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on sell conditions.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity with the reserved liquidity tokens and ETH.
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap external call.
addLiquidity performs the router addLiquidityETH external call.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning.
uniswapV2Router supplies the WETH address and receive the swap call.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
uniswapV2Pair balance is burned from in autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
uniswapV2Pair balance is burned from in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
marketingWallet is the destination of the final low-level value call.
devWallet is the destination of the low-level value call.
percentForLPBurn is multiplied into the pair balance to compute the burn amount.
tokensForLiquidity participates in the swapBack share arithmetic.
tokensForMarketing participates in the swapBack ETH share arithmetic.
tokensForDev participates in the swapBack ETH share arithmetic.
Liquidity token share determines the tokens supplied to addLiquidity.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading seeds lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount after scaling newNum by 1e18.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet after scaling newNum by 1e18.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the exclusion mapping.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exemption mapping.
updateBuyFees sums components into buyTotalFees.
updateSellFees sums components into sellTotalFees.
updateMarketingWallet writes the marketing wallet address.
updateDevWallet writes the dev wallet address.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the AMM pair mapping.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn with bounds checks.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes the lpBurnEnabled flag.
Low-level value call to the dev wallet can execute arbitrary code before state is fully finalized.
Low-level value call to the marketing wallet forwards the entire contract balance and can re-enter.
Router swap triggers token transfers that can call back into the token while swapping is active.
Router addLiquidityETH performs token transfers that can invoke token callbacks.
pair.sync() is an external call executed after burning, potentially interleaving with other flows.
pair.sync() is an external call executed after the manual burn.
from parameter drives exclusion, pair classification and transfer authorization.
to parameter drives pair classification, limits and fee determination.
amount parameter is subject to multiplication, division and subtraction fee arithmetic.
amount is multiplied by the total fee and divided by 100 to derive fees.
percent parameter is multiplied into the pair balance for the manual burn amount.
tokenAmount is approved and passed to the router swap.
newNum is validated against supply and scaled by 1e18.
newMarketingWallet is assigned to the marketing wallet state variable.
contractBalance is capped and split inside swapBack.
fees is subtracted from amount before the final transfer.
contractTokenBalance determines whether swapBack is triggered.
amountToBurn is computed from the pair balance and percentForLPBurn then transferred.
initialETHBalance is subtracted from the post-swap balance to compute ETH received.
liquidityTokens halves the contract balance and reduces the amount swapped for ETH.
